subject: general
question: In the given main characteristics of farming which is NOT a characteristic of the Indian commercial farming?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Slash and burn**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Slash and burn** is not a characteristic of Indian commercial farming.
 
• Indian commercial farming often uses **insecticides, pesticides, chemical fertilizers,** and **high yielding variety seeds** to increase productivity.
 
• **Slash and burn** is a method associated with **shifting agriculture**, not commercial farming.
 
• Commercial farming focuses on growing crops for sale and profit, utilizing modern agricultural techniques.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Commercial farming** in India includes crops like wheat, rice, cotton, and sugarcane.
 
• It involves significant investment in **agricultural technology and infrastructure**.
 
• Commercial farming aims to meet the demands of both **domestic and international markets**.
 
• The use of **modern irrigation techniques** and **mechanized tools** is common in commercial farming.
